filament_notes: Prusament PETG 1.75 mm for the 1.0 mm high-flow nozzle on T8 of the mixed-nozzle INDX printers. Prusa has no 1.0 PETG, so this follows Prusament PETG @COREONE HF0.8 (260 C, cap 37 mm3/s, fan 30-65, bridges 65, layer time 20/35 s) scaled to INDX (about 0.82, so a cap of 30 mm3/s, like the Sunlu T8 profile); bed 90/85 and flow 1.0 from Prusament PETG @COREONEINDX HF0.4; pressure advance 0.058 x0.447 (Prusa 0.4 to 0.8) x0.69 (0.8 to 1.0 step used for the CF profiles) = 0.018. Raise the cap with a max-flow test.
